castNote: Every on'yomi is played by one recurring character whose English name starts with or clearly contains that sound (ショウ = Showman, カン = Kangaroo): long readings ending in ウ/イ get a stretched vowel (コ Collie vs コウ Coach, ケ Kettle vs ケイ Cake), and endings in ク/ツ/ッ/キ/チ keep that consonant (コク Cockatoo, ジツ Jiu-jitsu fighter). Voiced readings (゛) use a sound-alike 'muddy cousin' of the unvoiced character, always shown splattered with two drops of mud like the two ゛ dots and, where possible, sharing its scene (シ Sheep / ジ Jeep, ショウ Showman / ジョウ Joker, コウ Coach / ゴウ Goalie, セン Sensei / ゼン Zen monk, ヒ Hippo / ビ Beaver), so mud always means ゛.

cards.story: A cosmic finger draws a single horizontal line across the universe, screeching and sizzling, slicing reality into exactly {one} dimension. An ~Itchy flea~ rides the line, scratching its one lonely leg.
